identity.name: RDP Session to Remote Host with Credential Theft
identity.summary: An attacker establishes an RDP session to a remote host and executes commands to extract credentials. Cortex should detect the rare RDP session and associated process behavior.
identity.description: An attacker establishes an RDP session to a remote host and executes commands to extract credentials. Cortex should detect the rare RDP session and associated process behavior.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare RDP Session to Remote Host
biocs.description: Detection of an RDP session to a remote host that is not typical for the user or host
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mstsc.exe'
| filter dst_port = 3389
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter agent_hostname != 'RDP-TEST-HOST'
| filter not (agent_hostname in ('RDP-TEST-HOST', 'RDP-DEV-HOST'))

abiocs.name: Unusual RDP Session with Credential Extraction
abiocs.description: RDP session followed by credential extraction commands
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mstsc.exe'
| filter dst_port = 3389
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter agent_hostname != 'RDP-TEST-HOST'
| filter not (agent_hostname in ('RDP-TEST-HOST', 'RDP-DEV-HOST'))
| join (dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'user.txt') on causality_actor_process_image_name = action_process_image_name
